configKeys.effect: Trigger text on line 1 of a sign that turns it into a BlueMap marker (case-insensitive, trimmed).
Display name of the marker layer in the BlueMap web UI.
Whether players can toggle the marker layer on/off in BlueMap.
Whether the marker layer starts hidden (players must enable it).
Max camera distance in blocks at which markers stay visible; a large value means always.

oneLiner: Put `[bm]` on the first line of any sign and that spot shows up as a labelled, icon-picked pin on your server's BlueMap web map — plus `/bmsigns` to place and edit pins that have no sign at all.

optionalMods.whatItAdds: The entire map integration. With BlueMap present the module creates/maintains a `vpa_map_signs` MarkerSet with POI markers (custom PNG icons, label, HTML-escaped popup detail, maxDistance) on every map of every world, and rebuilds it from persistence whenever BlueMap enables. Without BlueMap the module still initializes and registers `/bmsigns`, but `bluemapPresent` stays false: the sign hook, ChunkEvent.Load reconcile and BreakEvent handler all return early, so `[bm]` signs do nothing and nothing is ever persisted; `/bmsigns help` still prints the icon/command listing plus a red "BlueMap is not installed on this server" line, and list/add/addat/remove/edit refuse via requireBluemap().
optionalMods.evidence: src/main/java/net/geraldhofbauer/vanillaplusadditions/modules/bluemap_signs/BluemapSignsModule.java:44 (ModList.get().isLoaded("bluemap")); compat/BlueMapBridge.java:31-54; command/BluemapSignsCommands.java:249-255 (requireBluemap); build.gradle:162-167 (compileOnly + localRuntime); src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml:105-111 (type="optional", versionRange="[5.0,)", side="SERVER")

shortDescription: Turns [bm] signs into curated BlueMap markers; /bmsigns to manage them.
notes:
SOURCE FILES (all under modules/bluemap_signs/): BluemapSignsModule, IconKey, MapSignData, MapSignManager, MapSignMarker, MarkerBackend, SignReader, command/BluemapSignsCommands, compat/BlueMapBridge, config/BluemapSignsConfig. Mixin: mixin/bluemap_signs/SignBlockEntityTextMixin. Standalone entrypoint: standalone/bluemap_signs/BluemapSignsStandalone (@Mod("vpa_bluemap_signs")). Bundle registration: VanillaPlusAdditions.java:173.

SIDE - why "server": no Dist.CLIENT code, no rendering, no keybind, no Minecraft.getInstance(), no clientSetup() override anywhere in the module (grep for Dist/@OnlyIn/Minecraft.getInstance over modules/bluemap_signs/ returns only false positives from the identifier "maxDistance"). The mixin sits in the "mixins" (both-sides) block of vanillaplusadditions.mixins.json:11, but its only body calls BluemapSignsModule.onSignChanged, which bails unless sign.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel (BluemapSignsModule.java:72). The only client-visible artefacts are the chat lang strings for /bmsigns.

ENABLED BY DEFAULT: no override anywhere in the module or its config; it inherits Module.isEnabledByDefault() -> true (core/Module.java:73).

NO shouldInitialize() OVERRIDE: core/AbstractModule.java:112 provides the hook (and haunted_house, glider_water_repair, copycat_pathfinding, train_chunk_loading, pathfinder_quills, item_vault_viewer do override it), but bluemap_signs does NOT - it always initializes and always registers /bmsigns. BlueMap absence is handled by the runtime flag bluemapPresent, not by skipping init, so this is genuinely an optional, not a required, dependency.

HOW A SIGN BECOMES A MARKER: line 1 must equalsIgnoreCase(prefix.trim()) after Component.getString() strips formatting (so coloured/formatted signs work). Line 2 = label, line 3 = icon key (lower-cased), line 4 = popup detail; all four lines are .trim()ed. BOTH sign faces are read and the FIRST matching side wins (front checked before back, SignReader.readMarker) - if someone puts a different [bm] marker on each face, only the front one is ever used. Sign marker id is "s/" + Long.toUnsignedString(pos.asLong()); command marker id is "c<n>" from a persisted counter (MapSignData.nextCommandId). The BlueMap-side key is "<dimension>/<recordId>" (BlueMapBridge.markerId), and the marker is positioned at block centre (+0.5 on all three axes).

TRIGGER POINT: the mixin injects at RETURN of SignBlockEntity.setText(SignText, boolean) - i.e. a player finishing an edit / placing the sign - NOT on NBT load. Signs that already exist when the module is first enabled are picked up by the ChunkEvent.Load reconcile pass instead.

ICONS: 34 IconKey enum values, 34 PNGs in src/main/resources/assets/vanillaplusadditions/bluemap_icons/, 34 matching "command.vpa.bmsigns.icon.<key>" lang keys - verified by diffing all three sets, they are complete and in sync. Unknown or blank icon keys silently resolve to DEFAULT (IconKey.resolve). Icons are uploaded to BlueMap's WebApp once per BlueMapAPI enable (WebApp.createImage under "vanillaplusadditions/icons/<key>"); the anchor is (width/2, height), i.e. bottom-centre. If an icon fails to load, that marker falls back to POIMarker.defaultIcon().

*** PACKAGING GOTCHA (likely real bug, UNVERIFIED at runtime) ***: BlueMapBridge.loadImage uses BlueMapBridge.class.getResourceAsStream("/assets/vanillaplusadditions/bluemap_icons/<key>.png") (BlueMapBridge.java:100-106). In the standalone jar layout, moduleJar_bluemap_signs (build.gradle:629-661) packs ONLY modules/bluemap_signs/**, standalone/bluemap_signs/** and the mixin class - the bluemap_signs descriptor (build.gradle:398-399) declares no dataGlobs, and there is no asset glob mechanism for module jars at all. ALL assets/vanillaplusadditions/** live in vpa_core.jar instead (coreJar at build.gradle:603, the assets include at build.gradle:617). So in the standalone vpa_bluemap_signs.jar the icon PNGs sit in a DIFFERENT mod jar than the class doing the lookup. Whether that resource resolves across NeoForge's mod module layer could NOT be proven from the repository; if it does not, loadImage returns null for every key and every marker silently falls back to the default pin - no error, just plain pins. The all-in-one bundle jar is unaffected (one jar, all assets). This is the only getResourceAsStream in the whole src tree, so there is no precedent elsewhere in the repo either way. Worth an actual in-game check with the standalone jar before the docs claim custom icons work there.

RUNTIME-DISABLE HOLE: only the @SubscribeEvent handlers onChunkLoad / onBlockBreak and the static onSignChanged check isModuleEnabled(). onRegisterCommands does NOT, and the /bmsigns handlers never do either - they only check isBluemapPresent(). If the module is switched off in the config after startup, the command stays registered and /bmsigns add|edit|remove still mutates MapSignData and still pushes to BlueMap (the backend is never torn down). Disabling only takes proper effect on restart, where ModuleManager never calls initialize() for a disabled module (core/ModuleManager.java:104-107) and the command is therefore never registered. onServerStarting/onServerStopping are likewise ungated, but only set/clear the MinecraftServer reference.

SIGN REMOVAL IS NOT COMPLETE: BlockEvent.BreakEvent only fires for player breaks. A sign destroyed by an explosion, a piston, water flow, /setblock or /fill leaves its marker on the map until that chunk is unloaded and loaded again - ChunkEvent.Load -> reconcileChunk is what cleans up stale SIGN markers (it compares every SignBlockEntity in the chunk against the persisted markers whose pos falls in that ChunkPos). The same mechanism means reconcileChunk walks every block entity of every chunk on every chunk load while the module is active and BlueMap is present.

PERMISSIONS: the /bmsigns root is .requires(source -> true), so help and list are open to everyone; add, addat, remove and edit each require permission level 2 (op).

SIGN MARKERS ARE IMMUTABLE VIA COMMAND: removeCommandMarker/editCommandMarker return SIGN_IMMUTABLE for anything with Source.SIGN -> chat says "change or break the sign (line 1) to edit/remove it". The id suggestion provider already filters sign markers out (filter m -> !m.isSign()), so a sign id can only be hit by typing it manually.

DIMENSION HANDLING IS ASYMMETRIC: /bmsigns list takes an optional dimension argument, but add, addat, remove, edit and the id suggestions all hardcode ctx.getSource().getLevel(). You cannot edit a marker in another dimension from where you stand, and the "no marker with id %s" failure for a correct id in the wrong dimension is indistinguishable from a typo.

PERSISTENCE: MapSignData is a per-ServerLevel SavedData named "vanillaplusadditions_map_signs" (one file per dimension), and is the source of truth; BlueMap's MarkerSet (id "vpa_map_signs") is a mirror rebuilt from it on every BlueMapAPI enable (manager.rebuildAllFromStorage over server.getAllLevels(), dispatched onto the server thread via server.execute because BlueMap's callback may run on its own thread).

CONFIG CHANGES NEED A REBUILD: marker_set_name, toggleable and default_hidden are read when a MarkerSet is constructed, max_distance when a POIMarker is built. Existing markers/sets keep their old values until they are rebuilt (BlueMap re-enable / restart / next upsert of that marker). Changing prefix likewise does not retroactively drop markers created under the old prefix - they persist until each sign's chunk reloads and reconcileChunk finds no match.

ESCAPING: only detail is HTML-escaped (&, <, >), and it is only attached at all when non-blank. The label is passed to POIMarker.builder().label() unescaped. Blank labels render as the literal "(unnamed)" both on the map and in /bmsigns list.

ARCHITECTURE POINT WORTH KEEPING IN THE DOCS: compat/BlueMapBridge is the single class allowed to import de.bluecolored.*, behind the MarkerBackend interface, and it is instantiated only inside the ModList.isLoaded("bluemap") branch - this is the repo's canonical example of the optional-mod-gate pattern and is cited as such by docs/modules/overpacked_extensions.md:102.

BUILD DEPS: compileOnly libs/bluemap-5.7-neoforge.jar AND libs/flow-math-1.0.4-SNAPSHOT.jar (BlueMap's jar-in-jar Vector types used by the marker API - needed separately on the compile classpath); localRuntime only for the BlueMap jar (build.gradle:165-167). Unlike the four JARs the project CLAUDE.md calls out as missing, BOTH of these are COMMITTED to the repository (git ls-files libs/ lists them; .gitignore:72-75 only ignores sable/ToughAsNails/Quark/Zeta), so a fresh checkout compiles this module without any extra download.

STANDALONE JAR META: renderModuleToml (build.gradle:507-530) emits only vpa_core / neoforge / minecraft / moduleDeps / incompatible-with-bundle. The optional BlueMap dependency declared in the bundle's neoforge.mods.toml (lines 105-111, ordering=AFTER, side=SERVER) is therefore NOT present in vpa_bluemap_signs.jar's generated toml. BlueMapAPI.onEnable is a callback, so load ordering is probably irrelevant, but the asymmetry is real and untested.

LOCALISATION: 48 bmsigns lang keys (34 icon names + 14 message keys) exist in en_us.json and de_de.json only. de_at.json, fr_fr.json, es_es.json and cs_cz.json have zero - those locales fall back to English (or show raw keys, depending on fallback chain).

DOCS STATE: there is no docs/modules/bluemap_signs.md yet. The only prose is README.md:195-196 ("Turns `[bm]` signs into curated **BlueMap** markers; manage them with `/bmsigns`. Server-side; inert without BlueMap.") and the optional-mods table row README.md:240 ("Module stays inert (`[bm]` signs do nothing)"). That row slightly overstates the inertness: the module still initializes, still registers /bmsigns, and /bmsigns help still works without BlueMap.

NO items, blocks, entities, keybinds or recipes are registered by this module - grep for DeferredRegister/DeferredHolder/DeferredItem/DeferredBlock/RegistryObject/EntityType.Builder/KeyMapping/Recipe/AddReloadListener over modules/bluemap_signs/ and standalone/bluemap_signs/ returns nothing. It is purely events + command + SavedData + the BlueMap bridge.

HISTORY: introduced whole in 770d4ae (2026-07-01, first released in v1.0.0-beta.22). Two later commits touched module-related files: 27c7405 (beta.23) added standalone/bluemap_signs/BluemapSignsStandalone.java in the standalone-jar rollout, and d860a50 (beta.35) moved the mixin from mixin/SignBlockEntityTextMixin.java into the per-module subpackage mixin/bluemap_signs/ for the split-package fix. The module's own logic under modules/bluemap_signs/** is unchanged since 770d4ae.
